sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这里是《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantam.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·韦丹塔姆。

sentences.en: One of the most enduring puzzles of the human brain
sentences.zh: 人类大脑最持久的谜团之一

sentences.en: is that when we look inward, we see what feels like a complete picture.
sentences.zh: 就在于当我们向内审视时，我们看到的是一个似乎完整的画面。

sentences.en: We perceive our feelings, remember memories, and make plans for the future.
sentences.zh: 我们能感知情感、回忆往事，并为未来做计划。

sentences.en: Over the last several decades, however,
sentences.zh: 然而，在过去的几十年里，

sentences.en: psychologists have shown that significant portions of our minds
sentences.zh: 心理学家们已经表明，我们心灵的很大一部分

sentences.en: are, in fact, hidden from us.
sentences.zh: 事实上，对我们来说是隐藏的。

sentences.en: They operate outside or below the spotlight of conscious awareness.
sentences.zh: 它们在有意识觉察的聚光灯之外或下方运作。

sentences.en: Here's a simple way to demonstrate this.
sentences.zh: 这里有一个展示这一现象的简单方法。

sentences.en: I'll ask you a question, and you give me an answer.
sentences.zh: 我问你一个问题，然后你给我一个答案。

sentences.en: Here's the question.
sentences.zh: 问题来了。

sentences.en: Fill in the last word in this sentence.
sentences.zh: 请填出这句话中的最后一个词。

sentences.en: The 4th of July is celebrated as Independence Day in the United States of...
sentences.zh: 美国将7月4日庆祝为独立日...

sentences.en: blank.
sentences.zh: 空白处。

sentences.en: Okay, you think, that was too easy.
sentences.zh: 好吧，你心想，这也太简单了。

sentences.en: It's the United States of America, of course.
sentences.zh: 当然是美利坚合众国（United States of America）。

sentences.en: But take a moment and reflect on what just happened inside your brain.
sentences.zh: 但请花点时间回想一下刚才你的大脑里发生了什么。

sentences.en: You heard my question, which is to say,
sentences.zh: 你听到了我的问题，也就是说，

sentences.en: the sound waves carrying my voice entered your ear
sentences.zh: 承载我声音的声波进入了你的耳朵，

sentences.en: were converted into electrical signals and sent to your brain.
sentences.zh: 被转化为电信号并发送到你的大脑。

sentences.en: Neural networks transformed these signals into words, into a sentence,
sentences.zh: 神经网络将这些信号转化为词语、一个句子，

sentences.en: decoded what it meant, and figured out the meaning of the question.
sentences.zh: 解码了它的含义，并弄明白了问题的意思。

sentences.en: Systems in your brain that produce reasoning and memory
sentences.zh: 你大脑中负责产生推理和记忆的系统

sentences.en: retrieve the answer to the question.
sentences.zh: 检索出了这个问题的答案。

sentences.en: This answer was then routed to centers in the brain
sentences.zh: 然后，这个答案被输送到大脑中

sentences.en: that produce language.
sentences.zh: 负责产生语言的中心。

sentences.en: Other brain systems shaped how your muscles
sentences.zh: 其他大脑系统塑造了你的肌肉如何

sentences.en: pushed air through your lungs and pursed your lips,
sentences.zh: 推动空气穿过肺部并抿起嘴唇，

sentences.en: and you came up with America.
sentences.zh: 然后你想到了“美国”。

sentences.en: All those things had to happen for you to come up with the answer.
sentences.zh: 为了让你想出这个答案，所有这些事情都必须发生。

sentences.en: But notice how little you were aware
sentences.zh: 但请注意，你对

sentences.en: of these many extraordinary feats of neural wizardry.
sentences.zh: 这些非凡的神经奇迹壮举是多么毫无察觉。

sentences.en: The idea that much of our mental lives happens outside of conscious awareness
sentences.zh: 我们的许多精神生活发生在有意识觉察之外这一观点

sentences.en: is a key theme across this show.
sentences.zh: 是贯穿本节目的一个核心主题。

sentences.en: In nearly every Hidden Brain story,
sentences.zh: 在几乎每一个《隐藏的大脑》故事中，

sentences.en: we explore what happens beneath the surface of awareness,
sentences.zh: 我们都在探索觉察水面之下发生了什么，

sentences.en: in the realm of the unconscious,
sentences.zh: 在无意识的领域里，

sentences.en: in the kingdom of the implicit.
sentences.zh: 在内隐的王国里。

sentences.en: Today on the show, we launch a two-part miniseries.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目中，我们推出一个分两部分的迷你剧。

sentences.en: It's the story of a researcher who has spent a lifetime asking
sentences.zh: 这是一个关于某位研究人员的故事，她一生都在探究

sentences.en: how hidden mental forces shape how we think and what we do.
sentences.zh: 隐藏的心智力量如何塑造我们的思维和行动。

sentences.en: It's also the story of culture,
sentences.zh: 这也是一个关于文化的故事，

sentences.en: how the thoughts and feelings and actions of millions come together
sentences.zh: 数百万人的思想、情感和行为是如何汇聚在一起，

sentences.en: to create the foundation and the fissures of our society.
sentences.zh: 从而创造出我们社会的基石与裂痕的。

sentences.en: The strange interplay between our minds and the cultures in which we live.
sentences.zh: 我们的大脑与我们所生活的文化之间奇妙的相互作用。

sentences.en: This week on Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 本周的《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: Imagine, if you will, a little girl.
sentences.zh: 请想象一下，如果你愿意的话，一个小女孩。

sentences.en: It's late at night, and she is standing at a second-floor balcony at her home in southern India.
sentences.zh: 那是深夜，她正站在印度南部家中二楼的阳台上。

sentences.en: She is doing something strange.
sentences.zh: 她在做一件奇怪的事。

sentences.en: She is leaning into the air, her mouth agape.
sentences.zh: 她把身子探向空中，嘴巴大张着。

sentences.en: I remember a few really, really bad attacks where I would just try to bite into the air
sentences.zh: 我记得有几次非常非常严重的哮喘发作，我当时只想去咬空气，

sentences.en: to see if I could swallow slightly more air.
sentences.zh: 看看自己能不能多咽下去一点空气。

sentences.en: This is one of Mazarin Banaji's earliest memories of the asthma attacks that tormented her as a child.
sentences.zh: 这是马扎林·巴纳吉（Mazarin Banaji）对童年折磨她的哮喘发作的最早记忆之一。

sentences.en: She remembers also the label that came with her struggles.
sentences.zh: 她也记得随之而来的那个贴在她身上的标签。

sentences.en: I remember being called a sick child.
sentences.zh: 我记得自己被称为一个生病的儿童。

sentences.en: Our sick child needs X or our sick child needs that.
sentences.zh: 我们生病的儿童需要这个，或者我们生病的儿童需要那个。

sentences.en: And so it was very much a part of my identity that I was a sick child.
sentences.zh: 因此，“我是个生病的儿童”这很大程度上成了我身份的一部分。

sentences.en: And what that really meant was that I had been born prematurely, I had developed a very
sentences.zh: 而这真正的意思是，我出生时早产，在幼儿时期患上了非常

sentences.en: severe asthma as a toddler, and had a bunch of other autoimmune issues.
sentences.zh: 严重的哮喘，并伴有一堆其他的自身免疫问题。

sentences.en: So yeah, this inability to breathe got me very close to death a few times.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这种无法呼吸的感觉曾好几次让我濒临死亡。

sentences.en: And of course, the recovery from that is itself exhausting.
sentences.zh: 当然，从那之中恢复过来本身就是一件精疲力竭的事。

sentences.en: And more than me, I think if you talk to my siblings, they will tell you the trauma that
sentences.zh: 比起我，我想如果你去跟我兄弟姐妹谈谈，他们会告诉你

sentences.en: they experienced because their beds were in the same bedroom.
sentences.zh: 他们所经历的创伤，因为他们的床就在同一个卧室里。

sentences.en: And many times I would leave that
sentences.zh: 而且很多次我会离开那个

sentences.en: room just so they wouldn't have to hear me.
sentences.zh: 房间，只是为了让他们不用听见我的声音。

sentences.en: Mazarin's parents were devoted to her, but didn't
sentences.zh: 马扎林的父母对她疼爱有加，但对

sentences.en: have much faith in science and doctors.
sentences.zh: 科学和医生并没有太多信心。

sentences.en: Instead, they sought out healers from India's many religious
sentences.zh: 相反，他们四处寻找印度众多宗教

sentences.en: faith traditions.
sentences.zh: 信仰传统中的治疗师。

sentences.en: So the one I'll tell you about is a case where somebody was going to come to town
sentences.zh: 我要跟你讲的这个例子是，当时有人要来镇上，

sentences.en: and set up on the exhibition grounds in Hyderabad
sentences.zh: 在海得拉巴的展览场地上搭建一个摊位，

sentences.en: a cure for many things, including asthma.
sentences.zh: 声称能治愈许多疾病，包括哮喘。

sentences.en: It required that we leave home at four in the morning,
sentences.zh: 这要求我们在凌晨四点离开家，

sentences.en: that we get there early,
sentences.zh: 早早赶到那里，

sentences.en: that we then buy an earthenware pot that had water in it
sentences.zh: 然后去买一个装有水的土陶罐，

sentences.en: and a little fish swimming in it.
sentences.zh: 里面还有一条游来游去的小鱼。

sentences.en: We would stand in line for hours
sentences.zh: 我们要排几个小时的队，

sentences.en: and finally we would get to the man
sentences.zh: 最后终于见到那个男人，

sentences.en: who would take the fish, stick something into the fish's mouth
sentences.zh: 他会把鱼拿过来，从他的碗里

sentences.en: from a bowl that he had, like some flour or something,
sentences.zh: 弄点什么东西（比如面粉之类的）塞进鱼嘴里，

sentences.en: and then open my mouth and have me swallow this live fish.
sentences.zh: 然后打开我的嘴，让我把这只活鱼吞下去。

sentences.en: All I could think of was my mother and father love me
sentences.zh: 我脑子里想的全部就是，我的爸爸妈妈爱我，

sentences.en: and they're trying to do something good for me
sentences.zh: 他们正试图为我做一些好事，

sentences.en: and I'm going to go and swallow the fish and then I'm going to be fine.
sentences.zh: 只要我把鱼吞下去，我就会好起来的。

sentences.en: When that didn't work, Mazarin's mother turned to other healers.
sentences.zh: 当这招不管用时，马扎林的母亲便转向了其他治疗师。

sentences.en: To Muslim babas who would have you almost sort of strip down to your underwear
sentences.zh: 去找那些穆斯林巴巴（babas），他们会让你几乎脱得只剩内衣，

sentences.en: and then kind of whack you with peacock feathers.
sentences.zh: 然后用孔雀羽毛抽打你。

sentences.en: There were Baptist preachers.
sentences.zh: 还有浸礼会传道人。

sentences.en: They would put their hands on my head,
sentences.zh: 他们会把手放在我的头上，

sentences.en: and then they would each put their hands on each other's shoulders,
sentences.zh: 然后每个人把手搭在彼此的肩膀上，

sentences.en: and then they would pray.
sentences.zh: 接着他们开始祈祷。

sentences.en: And then they would, you know, sort of speak loudly and call for Jesus,
sentences.zh: 然后他们会，你知道的，大声说话并呼求耶稣，

sentences.en: and I would be the object of their focus.
sentences.zh: 而我则成了他们关注的焦点。

sentences.en: Sometimes Mazarin would ask herself
sentences.zh: 有时马扎林会问自己，

sentences.en: how these practitioners were so confident about their measures.
sentences.zh: 为什么这些从业者对他们的疗法如此自信。

sentences.en: How did they know their techniques worked?
sentences.zh: 他们怎么知道自己的技术管用呢？

sentences.en: As her doubts grew, she started running little tests
sentences.zh: 随着她的怀疑日益加深，她开始对各种干预措施的

sentences.en: into the efficacy of various interventions.
sentences.zh: 疗效进行一些小小的测试。

sentences.en: My mother found a little diary of mine from about that time,
sentences.zh: 我母亲找到了我大约那个时期的一本小日记，

sentences.en: from the time I was nine years old,
sentences.zh: 也就是我九岁时的日记，

sentences.en: in which I had started to write down
sentences.zh: 我在里面开始写下

sentences.en: how poorly I was feeling in terms of my breathing
sentences.zh: 我的呼吸感觉有多糟糕，

sentences.en: and whether I had prayed a lot or a little.
sentences.zh: 以及我祈祷得多还是少。

sentences.en: And I think I was trying to create a correlational table.
sentences.zh: 我想我当时是在试图制作一个相关性表格。

sentences.en: So when I didn't feel very good, sometimes I would pray a little,
sentences.zh: 所以当我感觉不太舒服时，有时我会祈祷一点，

sentences.en: sometimes I would pray a lot, sometimes I wouldn't pray at all.
sentences.zh: 有时我会祈祷很多，有时我根本不祈祷。

sentences.en: And what I wanted to see is if that variation was doing anything at all.
sentences.zh: 而我想看看这种变量是否真的起到了什么作用。

sentences.en: And so quite early, by the time I was 9 or 10,
sentences.zh: 所以在很小的时候，大概9、10岁时，

sentences.en: And I remember starting to say, I didn't want to go to these events.
sentences.zh: 我记得我开始说，我不想去参加这些活动了。

sentences.en: But Mazarin's mother insisted they keep trying.
sentences.zh: 但马扎林的母亲坚持要继续尝试。

sentences.en: The two of them quarreled.
sentences.zh: 母女俩吵了起来。

sentences.en: A woman showed up from Boston, Jane Shelton.
sentences.zh: 一个来自波士顿的女人出现了，简·谢尔顿（Jane Shelton）。

sentences.en: I remember her very well.
sentences.zh: 我记她记得很清楚。

sentences.en: She was a white American woman who had come from Boston to preach Christian science in India.
sentences.zh: 她是一个白人美国女性，从波士顿来到印度宣扬基督教科学派（Christian Science）。

sentences.en: And my mother converted, which meant don't see a doctor.
sentences.zh: 我母亲皈依了，这意味着不要去看医生。

sentences.en: I remember being terrified of Jane Shelton
sentences.zh: 我记得我很怕简·谢尔顿，

sentences.en: because she would come pick us up every Sunday morning
sentences.zh: 因为她每周日早上都会来接我们，

sentences.en: to take us to Sunday school
sentences.zh: 带我们去主日学校，

sentences.en: because in that phase we were Christian scientists.
sentences.zh: 因为在那段时间里我们是基督教科学派信徒。

sentences.en: Mazarin's schooling suffered, as did her emotional well-being.
sentences.zh: 马扎林的学业受到了影响，她的情感健康也是如此。

sentences.en: The less time she spent in school,
sentences.zh: 她在学校呆的时间越少，

sentences.en: the more she came to feel like she didn't belong at school.
sentences.zh: 她就越觉得自己不属于学校。

sentences.en: I just didn't have friends.
sentences.zh: 我根本没有朋友。

sentences.en: I was intensely lonely.
sentences.zh: 我感到极度的孤独。

sentences.en: I remember trying to just join a group of girls in the big school that I was attending.
sentences.zh: 我记得我曾试图融入我正在上的那所大学校里的一群女孩中。

sentences.en: And I remember many times that a group of girls would just sort of tighten their circle to physically remove me from it.
sentences.zh: 我还记得很多次，那群女孩会缩紧她们的圈子，好把我从物理上排挤出去。

sentences.en: And they were just being girls, mean girls, maybe, but just girls.
sentences.zh: 她们当时也只是在做女孩，也许是刻薄的女孩，但也就是女孩罢了。

sentences.en: But its impact on me was quite traumatic.
sentences.zh: 但它对我的影响却是相当具有创伤性的。

sentences.en: Even at home, I couldn't go outside.
sentences.zh: 甚至在家里，我也不能去外面。

sentences.en: So, you know, if I played in the dust with the other kids
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，如果我和其他孩子在灰尘里玩耍

sentences.en: or exerted myself, that would bring on, you know, an asthma attack.
sentences.zh: 或者过度劳累，就会引发哮喘发作。

sentences.en: And so as a result, I was forbidden from stepping outdoors.
sentences.zh: 因此，结果就是我被禁止踏出门外半步。

sentences.en: Like many children with limitations, Mazarin found other outlets.
sentences.zh: 就像许多身受限制的孩子一样，马扎林找到了其他的宣泄方式。

sentences.en: Reading came early, and she devoured books in her home,
sentences.zh: 她很早就开始阅读，并在家里如饥似渴地读书，

sentences.en: including books she didn't understand.
sentences.zh: 甚至包括她看不懂的书。

sentences.en: She couldn't play with other kids, but she could watch them.
sentences.zh: 她不能和其他孩子一起玩，但她可以观察他们。

sentences.en: I became an observer of human behavior in a way in which I could never have had I been a participant.
sentences.zh: 我成了一个人类行为的观察者，这是如果我作为参与者就绝不可能做到的。

sentences.en: So I had a literal perch on the second floor balcony, and I had this whole panorama of things going on.
sentences.zh: 所以我有一个二楼阳台上的绝佳视角，我能看到整个全景活动。

sentences.en: You know, kids would come back from school, and then they would go out and do their play.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，孩子们放学回来，然后出去玩耍。

sentences.en: And I watched them.
sentences.zh: 而我在看着他们。

sentences.en: When events occurred, a fight or something happened, people had very different reactions to it.
sentences.zh: 当事情发生时，比如一场打架什么的，人们对此会有非常不同的反应。

sentences.en: And so I think I noticed both sort of the general principles of human behavior.
sentences.zh: 所以我想我既注意到了人类行为的一些普遍原则，

sentences.en: Not that I was thinking this at all, but also just the variability with which people were responding to the very same thing.
sentences.zh: 倒不是说我当时在思考这些，但也注意到了人们对完全相同的事情做出反应时的差异性。

sentences.en: When I think back, I do feel that I was almost put in the place of an observer because of that being a sick child.
sentences.zh: 当我回想起来时，我确实觉得由于自己是个生病的儿童，我几乎被放到了一个观察者的位置上。

sentences.en: Finally, when she was 16, Mazarin put her foot down with her mother and won.
sentences.zh: 最后，在16岁时，马扎林在母亲面前态度坚决，并取得了胜利。

sentences.en: And I remember sort of our big standoff when I was 16 and I said, I want to go to see Dr. Menon,
sentences.zh: 我记得大约在我16岁时，我们有过一次激烈的对峙，我说我想去看梅农医生（Dr. Menon），

sentences.en: who was an allopathic medicine practitioner, a regular doctor.
sentences.zh: 他是一位西医从业者，也就是正规医生。

sentences.en: And Dr. Menon was just amazing.
sentences.zh: 梅农医生简直太棒了。

sentences.en: He sat me down and he made me a little booklet in which he said, this is what you have.
sentences.zh: 他让我坐下，并给我做了一个小册子，在上面写道，这就是你的病情。

sentences.en: We can control this.
sentences.zh: 我们可以控制它。

sentences.en: You don't have to suffer.
sentences.zh: 你不用受苦。

sentences.en: Use this inhaler.
sentences.zh: 用这个吸入器。

sentences.en: This is nothing more than a pair of sunglasses in the sun or a raincoat in the rain.
sentences.zh: 这就好比出太阳时戴副太阳镜，或者下雨天穿件雨衣。

sentences.en: And I will never forget that.
sentences.zh: 我永远不会忘记这一点。

sentences.en: And I could just feel this feeling of relief that what he was saying and what I was experiencing,
sentences.zh: 我能真切地感受到那种释怀，他所说的和我所经历的这一切，

sentences.en: that this was right, that in some way this was not something that you can cure, that it is something
sentences.zh: 都是对的，在某种程度上，这不是一种无法治愈的病，而是一种

sentences.en: that you control, and that there are ways to control it.
sentences.zh: 你可以控制的东西，并且有办法去控制它。

sentences.en: Yeah, but even if you couldn't cure
sentences.zh: 对，但即使你无法治愈它，

sentences.en: it, the fact that it is actually amenable to change must have been hugely heartening.
sentences.zh: 它其实能够被改变，这一事实一定非常鼓舞人心。

sentences.en: It was, but my mother was not happy.
sentences.zh: 确实如此，但我母亲并不高兴。

sentences.en: So what I found amazing is that the one thing that gave me
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得神奇的是，那件带给我

sentences.en: incredible hope.
sentences.zh: 难以置信希望的事，

sentences.en: My mother just almost felt let down by that, because to her, in her system,
sentences.zh: 我母亲却几乎感到失望，因为对她而言，在她的体系里，

sentences.zh: 所以我想，你知道，很明显我对记忆感兴趣。

sentences.en: Implicit memory is clearly interesting.
sentences.zh: 内隐记忆显然很有趣。

sentences.en: Let me start by replicating the Jacobi experiment.
sentences.zh: 让我从重复雅各比的实验开始。

sentences.en: Mazarin noticed that all the names that Larry Jacobi had used in his experiment were male names.
sentences.zh: 马扎林注意到拉里·雅各比在他的实验中使用的所有名字都是男性名字。

sentences.en: In her replication of the experiment, she included female names from the phone book.
sentences.zh: 在她对该实验的重复中，她纳入了电话本中的女性名字。

sentences.en: She fully expected to find exactly what the senior psychologist had found.
sentences.zh: 她满以为会发现这位资深心理学家所发现的完全一致的结果。

sentences.en: And so the first study results came back and showed Jacobi's result, but it was restricted to male names.
sentences.zh: 于是第一项研究结果出来了，显示了雅各比的结果，但仅限于男性名字。

sentences.en: Male names did become famous overnight.
sentences.zh: 男性名字确实一夜成名了。

sentences.en: Sebastian Weisdorf was more likely to be identified as famous, but in my case, Stephanie Weisdorf was not.
sentences.zh: 塞巴斯蒂安·韦斯多夫更容易被识别为名人，但在我的案例中，斯蒂芬妮·韦斯多夫则没有。

sentences.en: Why would male names from the phone book that the volunteers had seen a day or two earlier be seen as famous, but female names from the very same phone book not be seen this way?
sentences.zh: 为什么志愿者们一两天前在电话本上看到的男性名字会被视为名人，而来自同一个电话本的女性名字却不会被这样看待？

sentences.en: Mazarin was not interested in studying questions of bias,
sentences.zh: 马扎林对研究偏见问题并不感兴趣，

sentences.en: but the data told her that bias was at work.
sentences.zh: 但数据告诉她，偏见正在起作用。

sentences.en: Volunteers were using the filter of gender to reach their conclusions.
sentences.zh: 志愿者们正在使用性别的过滤器来得出他们的结论。

sentences.en: I started to quiz people after every experiment, after the first one.
sentences.zh: 在每个实验之后，在第一个实验之后，我开始对人们进行提问。

sentences.en: So in experiments two, three, four, five,
sentences.zh: 所以在实验二、三、四、五中，

sentences.en: I would ask every single subject at the end of the study,
sentences.zh: 我会在研究结束时询问每一位受试者，

sentences.en: I would say, what rule did you use to make your decision?
sentences.zh: 我会说，你做决定时用了什么规则？

sentences.en: And they would tell me.
sentences.zh: 他们会告诉我。

sentences.en: And if they didn't say anything about gender,
sentences.zh: 如果他们没有提到任何关于性别的内容，

sentences.en: I would say, did you use gender in making your decision?
sentences.zh: 我会说，你在做决定时使用性别了吗？

sentences.en: And they would look horrified and say, of course not.
sentences.zh: 他们会露出惊恐的表情说，当然没有。

sentences.en: And yet in their data, it was clear that they had.
sentences.zh: 然而在他们的数据中，很明显他们用了。

sentences.en: So for me, that's when the light bulb went off.
sentences.zh: 所以对我和来说，那就是灵光一现的时刻。

sentences.en: And I thought, if this is true,
sentences.zh: 我想，如果这是真的，

sentences.en: if people are doing this without any awareness,
sentences.zh: 如果人们在毫无察觉的情况下这样做，

sentences.en: it's got to be pretty pervasive.
sentences.zh: 那这一定是相当普遍的。

sentences.en: If volunteers were misapplying the filter of gender
sentences.zh: 如果志愿者们在涉及电话本中名字的实验室实验中

sentences.en: in a lab experiment involving names in a phone book,
sentences.zh: 错误地应用了性别的过滤器，

sentences.en: where else might they misapply the same filter?
sentences.zh: 他们在其他地方会不会也错误地应用同样的过滤器？

sentences.en: Could it shape how managers made hiring decisions?
sentences.zh: 它会塑造管理者做出雇佣决策的方式吗？

sentences.en: In medical treatment?
sentences.zh: 在医疗救治中？

sentences.en: In classrooms?
sentences.zh: 在教室里？

sentences.en: Mazarin had only to look around, of course, to see conscious sexism.
sentences.zh: 当然，马扎林环顾四周就能看到有意识的性别歧视。

sentences.en: TV shows and books and political debates were filled with open misogyny.
sentences.zh: 电视节目、书籍和政治辩论中充斥着公开的厌女症。

sentences.en: Let me just say, first of all, that I almost resent Vice President Bush,
sentences.zh: 首先，我要说的是，我几乎对副总统布什感到不满，

sentences.en: your patronizing attitude that you have to teach me about foreign policy.
sentences.zh: 你那种必须教导我外长政策的居高临下的态度。

sentences.en: What's my boy doing with the Barbie?
sentences.zh: 我的好儿子在对芭比娃娃做什么？

sentences.en: I've got to determine what your motivation might be.
sentences.zh: 我得弄清楚你的动机可能是什么。

sentences.en: Are you a scorned woman?
sentences.zh: 你是一个被抛弃的女人吗？

sentences.en: Don't consider age in the face of cleavage.
sentences.zh: 面对乳沟，别去考虑年龄。

sentences.en: This occurs on a molecular level.
sentences.zh: 这发生在分子水平上。

sentences.en: You can't control it.
sentences.zh: 你无法控制它。

sentences.en: But what had happened in this experiment was more interesting
sentences.zh: 但在这个实验中发生的事情更有趣

sentences.en: and more troubling.
sentences.zh: 也更令人不安。

sentences.en: It showed that people could be biased
sentences.zh: 它表明人们可能会心存偏见

sentences.en: without any awareness of being biased.
sentences.zh: 而完全没有意识到自己有偏见。

sentences.en: In many ways, this was worse than Garton-variety sexism
sentences.zh: 在许多方面，这比司空见惯的性别歧视更糟糕

sentences.en: because the people who had the bias
sentences.zh: 因为心存偏见的这些人

sentences.en: felt they were unbiased.
sentences.zh: 觉得自己是没有偏见的。

sentences.en: If implicit biases are hidden outside of conscious view,
sentences.zh: 如果内隐偏见隐藏在意识视野之外，

sentences.en: how do you reliably reveal their presence?
sentences.zh: 你如何才能可靠地揭示它们的存在？

sentences.en: Doctors run blood tests to measure cholesterol levels.
sentences.zh: 医生通过验血来测量胆固醇水平。

sentences.en: Mazarin wanted a test that could similarly measure implicit bias.
sentences.zh: 马扎林想要一个同样能够测量内隐偏见的测试。

sentences.en: She and her colleagues began to develop ideas.
sentences.zh: 她和她的同事们开始开发各种想法。

sentences.en: So for the next two years, I know that the Jacobi procedure is fine,
sentences.zh: 所以在接下来的两年里，我知道雅各比的程序很好，

sentences.en: but you need something where fame is not the main decision.
sentences.zh: 但你需要一个名气不是主要决定因素的东西。

sentences.en: You have to get at something closer to the association.
sentences.zh: 你必须找到更接近联想的东西。

sentences.en: Mazarin presented volunteers with words like chairman or chairwoman.
sentences.zh: 马扎林向志愿者展示了诸如主席或女主席之类的词。

sentences.en: She found that saying chair man subsequently made masculine concepts more accessible to volunteers,
sentences.zh: 她发现说男主席随后会让志愿者更容易接触到男性概念，

sentences.en: and using chair woman made feminine concepts more accessible.
sentences.zh: 而使用女主席则会让女性概念更容易接触到。

sentences.en: In many ways, this is intuitively obvious.
sentences.zh: 在许多方面，这是直观显而易见的。

sentences.en: When we hear the word salt, it's easier to bring to mind the word pepper rather than the word dinosaur.
sentences.zh: 当我们听到盐这个词时，更容易让人想起胡椒这个词，而不是恐龙这个词。

sentences.en: We've seen salt and pepper link together so many times that we have formed an implicit association between the two words.
sentences.zh: 我们看到盐和胡椒联系在一起那么多次，以至于我们在这两个词之间形成了内隐的联系。

sentences.en: What Mazarin and her colleagues were finding
sentences.zh: 马扎林和她的同事们发现的是

sentences.en: was that by measuring the speed of people's associations,
sentences.zh: 通过测量人们联想的速度，

sentences.en: they could peer into people's minds
sentences.zh: 他们可以窥探人们的内心世界

sentences.en: and tell which associations were strong
sentences.zh: 并分辨出哪些联想是强烈的

sentences.en: and which ones were weak.
sentences.zh: 哪些是薄弱的。

sentences.en: In 1994, Mazarin's PhD advisor, Tony Greenwald,
sentences.zh: 1994年，马扎林的博士生导师托尼·格林沃尔德，

sentences.en: now at the University of Washington
sentences.zh: 现任职于华盛顿大学

sentences.en: and a collaborator on the implicit bias research,
sentences.zh: 也是内隐偏见研究的合作者，

sentences.en: sent her an email.
sentences.zh: 给她发了一封电子邮件。

sentences.en: Tony's very terse.
sentences.zh: 托尼非常简练。

sentences.en: He writes brief emails.
sentences.zh: 他写的电子邮件很简短。

sentences.en: I got an email with a little program, and all he said is, try this.
sentences.zh: 我收到了一封带有小型程序的电子邮件，他只说，试试这个。

sentences.en: Tony had come up with a list of insects and a list of flowers.
sentences.zh: 托尼想出了一份昆虫名单和一份花卉名单。

sentences.en: Words from these lists popped up on Mazarin's screen.
sentences.zh: 这些名单上的词语弹出了马扎林的屏幕上。

sentences.en: Insect and flower, and if an insect pops up, I should say left,
sentences.zh: 昆虫和花，如果弹出一个昆虫，我应该说左，

sentences.en: and if a flower pops up, I should say right, and I just use the two keys,
sentences.zh: 如果弹出一朵花，我应该说右，我只用这两个键，

sentences.en: E for left, I for right, and it's very simple.
sentences.zh: E代表左，I代表右，这非常简单。

sentences.en: If I see rose, I say it's a flower, and I press the left key.
sentences.zh: 如果我看到玫瑰，我说这是一朵花，我按左键。

sentences.en: If it says bug or something like that, I say right key.
sentences.zh: 如果它说虫子或类似的东西，我按右键。

sentences.en: Mazarin blazed through the teSt.
sentences.zh: 马扎林轻而易举地完成了测试。

sentences.en: It was ridiculously easy.
sentences.zh: 这简直简单得可笑。

sentences.en: Next, Toni had her classify a set of words as positive or negative words.
sentences.zh: 接下来，托尼让她将一组词分类为积极的词或消极的词。

sentences.en: This is very easy.
sentences.zh: 这非常简单。

sentences.en: How hard is it to say a word like peace is a good word?
sentences.zh: 说像和平这样的词是个好词有多难？

sentences.en: How hard is it to say that a word like nasty is a bad word?
sentences.zh: 说像讨厌这样的词是个坏词有多难？

sentences.en: You can do that, too.
sentences.zh: 你也能做到这一点。

sentences.en: You can use two keys to say which one's good and which one's bad.
sentences.zh: 你可以用两个键来表示哪个是好的，哪个是坏的。

sentences.en: A third grader would have no trouble with the task.
sentences.zh: 三年级学生做这个任务也不会有任何问题。

sentences.en: The next part of the test asked Mazarin to group together all the flower words with all the positive words.
sentences.zh: 测试的下一部分要求马扎林将所有花卉词汇与所有积极词汇归为一组。

sentences.en: If she saw either rose or peace, she had to press the left key.
sentences.zh: 如果她看到玫瑰或和平，她必须按左键。

sentences.en: If she saw either bug or nasty, she had to press the right key.
sentences.zh: 如果她看到虫子或讨厌，她必须按右键。

sentences.en: This was also really easy to do.
sentences.zh: 这也是非常容易做到的。

sentences.en: Then came the twiSt.
sentences.zh: 接着转折来了。

sentences.en: Tony asked Mazarin to group all the flowers with negative words on one side
sentences.zh: 托尼让马扎林将一侧的所有花卉与消极词汇归为一组

sentences.en: and the insects with positive words on the other.
sentences.zh: 另一侧将昆虫与积极词汇归为一组。

sentences.en: Effectively, the test was asking Mazarin to link together words like bug and cockroach
sentences.zh: 实际上，测试要求马扎林将虫子和蟑螂之类的词

sentences.en: with words like peace and joy.
sentences.zh: 与和平和喜悦之类的词联系起来。

sentences.en: Since most of us don't associate insects with positive concepts,
sentences.zh: 既然我们大多数人不会把昆虫与积极的概念联系起来，

sentences.en: it took Mazarin more effort to do this part of the teSt.
sentences.zh: 马扎林花费了更多的努力来完成测试的这一部分。

sentences.en: And you realize that it is not at all easy to do.
sentences.zh: 你会意识到这绝非易事。

sentences.en: You're making mistakes, you're taking long to do it,
sentences.zh: 你在犯错，你花了很长时间才完成它，

sentences.en: and you feel the failure of your brain.
sentences.zh: 并且你能感受到你大脑的罢工。

sentences.en: You're feeling it in real time that your brain has just stopped working.
sentences.zh: 你实时地感觉到你的大脑刚刚停止了工作。

sentences.en: As she did the test, Mazarin already understood why this last section was hard.
sentences.zh: 在做测试时，马扎林已经明白了为什么最后这部分很难。

sentences.en: Implicitly, hidden away from conscious view,
sentences.zh: 在潜意识里，隐藏在有意识的视野之外，

sentences.en: we have a set of associations with flowers and insects.
sentences.zh: 我们对花卉和昆虫有一套联想。

sentences.en: Our associations with flowers are generally positive.
sentences.zh: 我们对花卉的联想通常是积极的。

sentences.en: Our associations with insects are generally negative.
sentences.zh: 我们对昆虫的联想通常是消极的。

sentences.en: There was a second test Tony had included in his email.
sentences.zh: 托尼在他的电子邮件中还附带了第二个测试。

sentences.en: There were positive and negative words as before,
sentences.zh: 像以前一样有积极和消极的词汇，

sentences.en: but now, instead of flowers and insects,
sentences.zh: 但现在，不再是花卉和昆虫，

sentences.en: Tony gave Mazarin a list of names traditionally used by black people
sentences.zh: 托尼给了马扎林一份黑人传统上使用的名字名单

sentences.en: and a list of names traditionally used by white people.
sentences.zh: 和一份白人传统上使用的名字名单。

sentences.en: He asked her to pair white names with positive words
sentences.zh: 他要求她把白人名字与积极词汇配对

sentences.en: and black names with negative words.
sentences.zh: 把黑人名字与消极词汇配对。

sentences.en: Mazarin found this was as easy to do
sentences.zh: 马扎林发现这和做这件事一样容易

sentences.en: as pairing flowers with positive words
sentences.zh: 就像把花卉与积极词汇配对

sentences.en: and insects with negative words.
sentences.zh: 以及把昆虫与消极词汇配对一样。

sentences.en: Then Tony flipped the groupings.
sentences.zh: 然后托尼反转了分组。

sentences.en: He asked Mazarin to pair white names with negative words
sentences.zh: 他要求马扎林将白人名字与消极词汇配对

sentences.en: and black names with positive words.
sentences.zh: 将黑人名字与积极词汇配对。

sentences.en: I've already done the insect flower task,
sentences.zh: 我已经做过昆虫与花朵的任务了，

sentences.en: So I know that, aha, I see what we're doing here.
sentences.zh: 所以我知道，啊哈，我知道我们在这里做什么。

sentences.en: But I'm not prepared at all for the pit in my stomach that I'm going to experience
sentences.zh: 但我完全没有准备好去面对内心深处的恐惧

sentences.en: when I come to the moment when I have to associate white with bad and black with good.
sentences.zh: 当我走到那个必须将白色与坏、黑色与好的概念联系起来的时刻时。

sentences.en: Even, how shall I say this?
sentences.zh: 甚至，我该怎么说呢？

sentences.en: I knew what this test was trying to do.
sentences.zh: 我知道这个测试是想做什么。

sentences.en: I've done dozens of these kinds of things before.
sentences.zh: 我以前做过几十次这种测试。

sentences.en: But there was something about that moment that I say even today it was the single most transformative moment in my life.
sentences.zh: 但那个时刻有些特别，以至于我直到今天都说这是我一生中最具颠覆性的时刻。

sentences.en: The test was telling me that my mind could not associate black with good as easily as it could associate white with good.
sentences.zh: 测试告诉我，我的大脑无法像把白色与好联系起来那样轻易地把黑色与好联系起来。

sentences.en: That is not my view of myself.
sentences.zh: 这并不是我对自己的看法。

sentences.en: That is to say, I believe that if I choose to, I can associate anything with good and with bad.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，我相信如果我选择的话，我可以把任何东西与好和坏联系起来。

sentences.en: It's up to me to decide what I want to do.
sentences.zh: 由我来决定我想做什么。

sentences.en: This test took away all of that.
sentences.zh: 这个测试夺走了这一切。

sentences.en: This test said, you can try to do that, but I'm going to show you,
sentences.zh: 这个测试说，你可以试着那样做，但我会向你展示，

sentences.en: you really cannot do certain things as easily as you can do others.
sentences.zh: 你确实无法像做其他事情那样轻而易举地做到某些事情。

sentences.en: And as a psychologist, I knew that that ease meant something more than just ease of doing the teSt.
sentences.zh: 而作为一名心理学家，我知道这种轻松感不仅仅意味着完成测试的轻松。

sentences.en: It meant that my brain had received the thumbprint of the culture so deeply that I had no control over this.
sentences.zh: 这意味着我的大脑已经深深打上了文化的烙印，以至于我对这一切毫无控制力。

sentences.en: The feeling was a feeling of dread.
sentences.zh: 这种感觉是一种恐惧感。

sentences.en: I would say, a feeling of having had the rug pulled out from under you.
sentences.zh: 可以说，是一种被人抽走脚底地毯的感觉。

sentences.en: This is like a moral death that you're experiencing
sentences.zh: 这就像是你正在经历一场道德上的死亡

sentences.en: because everything you've believed is being taken apart in front of your very eyes
sentences.zh: 因为你所相信的一切都在你眼前被瓦解了

sentences.en: and you are left with nothing.
sentences.zh: 而你变得一无所有。

sentences.en: You have to start from scratch to now rebuild a view of yourself
sentences.zh: 你必须从头开始，现在重新构建一个对自己的看法

sentences.en: that will forever be a different view of yourself.
sentences.zh: 这将永远是一个对自己的不同看法。

sentences.en: It was a painful moment, but it was also the beginning of a profound turning point in Mazarin's career.
sentences.zh: 这是一个痛苦的时刻，但它也是马扎林职业生涯中一个深刻转折点的开始。

sentences.en: She and Tony Greenwald would take this insight about our minds and develop a now-famous teSt.
sentences.zh: 她和托尼·格林沃尔德将利用对我们大脑的这种深刻理解，开发出一个如今闻名遐迩的测试。

sentences.en: It's one that millions of people around the world have taken to try to better understand the workings of their minds.
sentences.zh: 这是全球数百万人为了更好地了解自己大脑运作方式而做过的测试。

sentences.en: When we come back, Mazarin's work receives the kind of attention most scientists never dream of.
sentences.zh: 当我们回来时，马扎林的工作受到了大多数科学家做梦也想不到的关注。

sentences.en: But not all of it is positive.
sentences.zh: 但并非所有的关注都是积极的。

sentences.en: You know, enough of this seeking every opportunity to demean law enforcement broadly
sentences.zh: 你知道，够了，别再到处寻找任何机会来普遍贬低执法部门

sentences.en: by making the accusation of implicit bias every time tragedy...
sentences.zh: 每当悲剧发生时，就指责存在内隐偏见……

sentences.en: You're listening to Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 您正在收听的是《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantam.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·韦丹塔姆。

sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这里是《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantam.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·韦丹塔姆。

sentences.en: After Tony Greenwald sent Mazurine Banalji the test that revealed her own hidden biases to her,
sentences.zh: 在托尼·格林沃尔德将向马扎林·班纳吉揭示她自身隐藏偏见的测试发送给她之后，

sentences.en: they and other researchers took this insight and developed something called the Implicit Association TeSt.
sentences.zh: 他们和其他研究人员利用这一洞察力开发了一种名为“内隐联想测验”的东西。

sentences.en: It measures our hidden associations.
sentences.zh: 它测量我们隐藏的联想。

sentences.en: Tests like the one Mazarin took have now been used by millions of people.
sentences.zh: 像马扎林做的那样的测试现在已被数百万人使用。

sentences.en: They offer a window into the minds of Americans, and not everyone likes what they see.
sentences.zh: 它们为我们提供了一个窥探美国人内心世界的窗口，而且并非所有人对他们所看到的东西都感到满意。

sentences.en: After Mazarin Banaji moved to Harvard University,
sentences.zh: 在马扎林·班纳吉搬到哈佛大学之后，

sentences.en: the school began hosting a number of her tests at a website, implicit.harvard.edu.
sentences.zh: 学校开始在 implicit.harvard.edu 网站上托管她的多项测试。

sentences.en: The tests are free and can be taken by anyone with a computer and an internet connection.
sentences.zh: 这些测试是免费的，任何拥有电脑和网络连接的人都可以进行。

sentences.en: People around the world have taken tests that measure their attitudes about race and sexual orientation.
sentences.zh: 世界各地的人们都参加了旨在衡量他们对种族和性取向看法的测试。

sentences.en: Other tests measure implicit attitudes about the poor, the elderly, and people who are overweight.
sentences.zh: 其他测试则衡量对穷人、老年人和超重人群的内隐态度。

sentences.en: Almost from the start, the Implicit Association Test, or IAT, produced strong reactions.
sentences.zh: 几乎从一开始，内隐联想测验（简称 IAT）就引发了强烈的反应。

sentences.en: Many people responded with shame, guilt, and anger.
sentences.zh: 许多人的反应是羞愧、内疚和愤怒。

sentences.en: Others hailed the test, saying it could explain vast disparities we see in societies today,
sentences.zh: 另一些人则称赞该测试，称它可以解释我们今天在社会中看到的巨大差异，

sentences.en: including in communities of people who pride themselves on being deeply egalitarian.
sentences.zh: 包括在那些以深信平等主义而自豪的群体中。

sentences.en: In the early days of the test, a physician named Alexander Green reached out to Mazarin.
sentences.zh: 在测试的早期，一位名叫亚历山大·格林的医生联系了马扎林。

sentences.en: Alex, who worked in a medical school, was interested in this question of whether implicit
sentences.zh: 在医学院工作的亚历克斯对这样一个问题很感兴趣：内隐

sentences.en: bias might be playing a role in the decisions of medical professionals, because in his experience,
sentences.zh: 偏见是否在医疗专业人员的决策中发挥了作用，因为根据他的经验，

sentences.en: medical professionals are among the most egalitarian people we know, he said.
sentences.zh: 医疗专业人员是我们所知道的最具平等主义精神的人群之一，他说。

sentences.en: This is a profession that takes an oath.
sentences.zh: 这是一个需要发誓的职业。

sentences.en: And yet, if you look at the data, we now have
sentences.zh: 然而，如果你看看数据，我们现在拥有

sentences.en: not dozens, but hundreds of studies that have been done looking at many kinds of disparities,
sentences.zh: 的不是几十项，而是数百项研究，这些研究着眼于许多种类的差异，

sentences.en: but especially at racial disparities in health care.
sentences.zh: 尤其是医疗保健中的种族差异。

sentences.en: And so he was puzzled by this.
sentences.zh: 因此，他对这一点感到困惑。

sentences.en: You know, how is it possible that these people who try so hard every day
sentences.zh: 你知道，这些每天都在努力克服

sentences.en: to overcome the challenges that are being posed by racism
sentences.zh: 种族主义所带来的挑战的人们，怎么会

sentences.en: are in their own behavior showing certain systematic effects
sentences.zh: 在他们自己的行为中表现出某些系统性效应，

sentences.en: that mimic the very thing that they would criticize?
sentences.zh: 从而模仿了他们所批判的东西呢？

sentences.en: And then maybe, you know, it is not conscious bias.
sentences.zh: 然后也许，你知道，这不是有意识的偏见，

sentences.en: but that there is a certain kind of bias that we can now measure that may be playing a role.
sentences.zh: 而是某种我们现在可以测量的偏见可能在其中发挥了作用。

sentences.en: Mazarin and Alex gave doctors in Atlanta and Boston a case study, a medical scenario.
sentences.zh: 马扎林和亚历克斯给亚特兰大和波士顿的医生们提供了一个案例研究，一个医疗场景。

sentences.en: It described a Mr. Thompson who comes into the hospital complaining of chest pains.
sentences.zh: 它描述了一位汤普森先生，他来到医院主诉胸痛。

sentences.en: The case study gave a medical history of Mr. Thompson and asked the physicians
sentences.zh: 案例研究提供了汤普森先生的病史，并询问医生

sentences.en: if they would prescribe clot-busting treatments that could prevent a stroke.
sentences.zh: 他们是否会开出能够预防中风的溶栓治疗药物。

sentences.en: All the physicians saw the same case study,
sentences.zh: 所有的医生看到的都是同一个案例研究，

sentences.en: except that some were told Mr. Thompson was white,
sentences.zh: 只是有些人被告知汤普森先生是白人，

sentences.en: and others were told he was black.
sentences.zh: 而另一些人则被告知他是黑人。

sentences.en: Everything is the same.
sentences.zh: 一切都是一样的。

sentences.en: It's just that the person is either black or white,
sentences.zh: 只是这个人要么是黑人，要么是白人，

sentences.en: but the data that you see are the same.
sentences.zh: 但你看到的数据是相同的。

sentences.en: And the medical professional is asked,
sentences.zh: 然后医疗专业人员被问到，

sentences.en: would you prescribe thrombolysis,
sentences.zh: 你会不会开溶栓药，

sentences.en: which I believe is prescribed in some cases
sentences.zh: 我相信这在某些

sentences.en: that present with these symptoMs.
sentences.zh: 表现出这些症状的病例中是会开的。

sentences.en: The researchers found a small racial disparity.
sentences.zh: 研究人员发现存在微小的种族差异。

sentences.en: physicians were slightly less likely to recommend the clot-busting treatments to the black Mr.
sentences.zh: 与白人汤普森先生相比，医生向黑人汤普森

sentences.en: Thompson compared to the white Mr. Thompson.
sentences.zh: 先生推荐溶栓治疗的可能性略低一些。

sentences.en: But when the researchers had the physicians take
sentences.zh: 但是，当研究人员让医生们参加

sentences.en: an implicit association test, or IAT, a curious pattern emerged.
sentences.zh: 内隐联想测验（即 IAT）时，一个有趣的模式出现了。

sentences.en: When you add in the IAT, what you
sentences.zh: 当你加入 IAT 数据后，你

sentences.en: saw is that doctors who showed higher anti-black bias on the IAT were also the ones who decided to
sentences.zh: 会发现，在 IAT 上表现出较高反黑人偏见的医生，同时也决定了

sentences.en: withhold thrombolysis to Black patients.
sentences.zh: 对黑人患者不予进行溶栓治疗。

sentences.en: Soon, new data was coming in on multiple fronts.
sentences.zh: 很快，多方面的新数据涌现出来。

sentences.en: One question Mazarin had was when these biases get into people's heads.
sentences.zh: 马扎林的一个疑问是，这些偏见是什么时候进入人们脑海的。

sentences.en: No one is born with
sentences.zh: 没有人天生就带有

sentences.en: these biases, so are they learned in early childhood, in adolescence, in adulthood?
sentences.zh: 这些偏见，那么它们是在童年早期、青春期还是成年期学会的？

sentences.en: After Mazarin moved to Harvard, she started running experiments comparing six-year-olds,
sentences.zh: 马扎林搬到哈佛后，开始进行对比六岁儿童、

sentences.en: 10-year-olds, and adults.
sentences.zh: 十岁儿童和成人的实验。

sentences.en: And I assumed at that time that the data would show
sentences.zh: 我当时假设数据会显示

sentences.en: that five- and six-year-olds would show no bias at all
sentences.zh: 五六岁的儿童根本不会表现出任何偏见

sentences.en: because their experience in the world,
sentences.zh: 因为他们在世界上的经历，

sentences.en: on race in particular, these are kids in Cambridge,
sentences.zh: 特别是在种族方面，这些是剑桥的孩子，

sentences.en: this is not a city with a large black population,
sentences.zh: 这不是一个黑人人口很多的城市，

sentences.en: that these are kids who would show no bias at all,
sentences.zh: 这些孩子将完全不表现出偏见，

sentences.en: it should be zero.
sentences.zh: 应该为零。

sentences.en: And then maybe, you know,
sentences.zh: 然后也许，你知道的，

sentences.en: 10-year-olds have picked up a little bit
sentences.zh: 十岁的孩子已经沾染了一点点

sentences.en: and then to compare those two,
sentences.zh: 为了对比这两者，

sentences.en: we picked adults at the same time.
sentences.zh: 我们同时选择了成年人。

sentences.en: So we could get data from three groups,
sentences.zh: 这样我们就可以从三组人那里获得数据，

sentences.en: six-year-olds, ten-year-olds, and adults.
sentences.zh: 六岁儿童、十岁儿童和成人。

sentences.en: And we also asked them questions, of course.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们还问了他们一些问题。

sentences.en: You know, if you have two people in front of you,
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果你面前有两个人，

sentences.en: which one do you prefer?
sentences.zh: 你更喜欢哪一个？

sentences.en: The researchers showed volunteers two photos.
sentences.zh: 研究人员向志愿者展示了两张照片。

sentences.en: One showed a black person, the other showed a white person.
sentences.zh: 一张显示一个黑人，另一张显示一个白人。

sentences.en: So that was the explicit measure,
sentences.zh: 所以那是显性测量，

sentences.en: the one where you could exert conscious awareness if you wanted to
sentences.zh: 如果你愿意，你可以在其中发挥有意识的觉知

sentences.en: and say whatever you feel is right for you.
sentences.zh: 并说出你认为对你来说正确的事情。

sentences.en: On the explicit measure, adults told Mazrin
sentences.zh: 在显性测量上，成年人告诉马扎林

sentences.en: they had no preferences at all.
sentences.zh: 他们根本没有任何偏好。

sentences.en: They lacked the black face and white face equally.
sentences.zh: 他们对黑人面孔和白人面孔的喜爱程度不相上下。

sentences.en: This is in line with other reports that find
sentences.zh: 这与其他报告一致，这些报告发现

sentences.en: very few Americans admit to having racial biases of any kind.
sentences.zh: 很少有美国人承认自己有任何形式的种族偏见。

sentences.en: Ten-year-olds are showing a little bit of bias
sentences.zh: 十岁的孩子表现出了一点点偏见

sentences.en: favoring their own group.
sentences.zh: 偏爱他们自己的群体。

sentences.en: So when asked, they would say,
sentences.zh: 因此当被问到时，他们会说，

sentences.en: they would try to pick equally,
sentences.zh: 他们会试图平等地选择，

sentences.en: but they tended to prefer white if they were white.
sentences.zh: 但如果他们是白人，他们往往会更喜欢白人。

sentences.en: And in this study, it was only white kids, the first one.
sentences.zh: 在这项研究中，全部都是白人小孩，这是第一项研究。

sentences.en: Six-year-olds were just honeSt.
sentences.zh: 六岁的孩子只是很诚实。

sentences.en: They would just pick the white kid much of the time, 80% of the time, they were saying.
sentences.zh: 他们在很多时候都会选择白人小孩，据他们说，80% 的时候都是如此。

sentences.en: So what we saw was, in fact, quite clear differences in explicits with the greatest bias being expressed by six-year-olds,
sentences.zh: 因此我们看到的是，在显性测量上实际上有着非常明显的差异，表现出最大偏见的是六岁儿童，

sentences.en: slightly less bias expressed by 10-year-olds, and adults being completely neutral.
sentences.zh: 十岁儿童表现出的偏见略少，而成年人则完全是中立的。

sentences.en: Then the researchers turned to the IAT data.
sentences.zh: 接着研究人员转向了 IAT 数据。

sentences.en: Would there be a difference between six-year-olds,
sentences.zh: 六岁儿童、

sentences.en: 10-year-olds, and adults
sentences.zh: 十岁儿童和成人之间

sentences.en: when it came to their implicit associations on race?
sentences.zh: 在种族内隐联想方面会存在差异吗？

sentences.en: Mazarin thought she would find
sentences.zh: 马扎林本以为她会发现

sentences.en: the youngest children had no implicit bias,
sentences.zh: 年龄最小的孩子没有内隐偏见，

sentences.en: the older children would have some,
sentences.zh: 稍大一点的孩子会有一些，

sentences.en: and then adults would have a lot of it.
sentences.zh: 然后成年人会有很多。

sentences.en: If implicit associations are picked up
sentences.zh: 如果内隐联想是通过

sentences.en: by being exposed to people from different walks of life,
sentences.zh: 接触来自各行各业的人而习得的，

sentences.en: wouldn't this be what you'd expect?
sentences.zh: 难道这不正是你所预料的吗？

sentences.en: And we did not see that.
sentences.zh: 但我们并没有看到这一点。

sentences.en: The data showed, you know,
sentences.zh: 数据显示，你知道，

sentences.en: almost millisecond-level similarity in the data of 6-year-olds, 10-year-olds, and adults.
sentences.zh: 六岁儿童、十岁儿童和成人的数据在几乎毫秒级的水平上是相似的。

sentences.en: In other words, the 6-year-olds in white culture looked like white adults, no different from them.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，白人文化中的六岁儿童看起来就像白人成人，与他们没有区别。

sentences.en: It changed my view about what it is that the IAT might be tapping into.
sentences.zh: 这改变了我对 IAT 可能正在触及的东西的看法。

sentences.en: and it told me that what this test is tapping into
sentences.zh: 它告诉我，这个测试所触及的东西

sentences.en: is something that emerges early in life
sentences.zh: 是在生命早期就出现的东西

sentences.en: and whether you have seen any people
sentences.zh: 而不管你是否见过任何人

sentences.en: and know any people in those groups or not,
sentences.zh: 无论是否认识这些群体里的人，

sentences.en: you are going to show this bias.
sentences.zh: 你都会表现出这种偏见。

sentences.en: The test revolutionized the study of bias seemingly overnight.
sentences.zh: 这项测试似乎在一夜之间彻底改变了偏见研究。

sentences.en: Within a few short years,
sentences.zh: 在短短几年内，

sentences.en: companies were mandating employees take Mazarin's tests
sentences.zh: 各大公司纷纷强制员工参加马扎林的测试，

sentences.en: to help employees identify their implicit biases.
sentences.zh: 以帮助员工识别自己的内隐偏见。

sentences.en: A vast training industry popped up,
sentences.zh: 庞大的培训行业应运而生，

sentences.en: offering to help people rid themselves of their unconscious biases.
sentences.zh: 声称能帮人们摆脱无意识偏见。

sentences.en: Social justice advocates seized on the tests.
sentences.zh: 社会正义倡导者们迅速抓住了这些测试。

sentences.en: Here, finally, was a way to explain vast disparities
sentences.zh: 这终于提供了一种方式，来解释他们所看到的巨大差距：

sentences.en: they were seeing in classrooms, in health care settings,
sentences.zh: 无论是在教室里、医疗环境中，

sentences.en: and in the criminal justice system.
sentences.zh: 还是在刑事司法系统中。

sentences.en: But even as some people were excited
sentences.zh: 然而，正当一些人为该测试

sentences.en: by the potential of the test to transform social policy,
sentences.zh: 改变社会政策的潜力感到兴奋时，

sentences.en: others were increasingly upset.
sentences.zh: 另一些人却日益感到不安。

sentences.en: Some researchers felt that claims about the IAT
sentences.zh: 一些研究人员认为，关于内隐偏见测试（IAT）

sentences.en: and what it could tell us were going too far, too faSt.
sentences.zh: 及其揭示内容的说法走得太远、太快了。

sentences.en: And one study started to show that conservative parts of the United States
sentences.zh: 一项研究开始显示，美国保守派地区的

sentences.en: had larger implicit biases than liberal places.
sentences.zh: 内隐偏见比自由派地区更严重。

sentences.en: The tests exploded into political controversy.
sentences.zh: 这些测试瞬间引发了政治争议。

sentences.en: The pinnacle of the controversy came in 2016
sentences.zh: 争议的顶峰出现在2016年，

sentences.en: when presidential candidate Hillary Clinton
sentences.zh: 当时总统候选人希拉里·克林顿

sentences.en: said she thought implicit biases were widespread across society.
sentences.zh: 表示她认为内隐偏见在全社会广泛存在。

sentences.en: This was during a debate with Republican candidate Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 这是在与共和党候选人唐纳德·特朗普的辩论期间。

sentences.en: Too many of us in our great country jump to conclusions about each other.
sentences.zh: 我们伟大国家中的许多人对彼此妄下结论。

sentences.en: And therefore, I think we need all of us to be asking hard questions about, you know, why am I feeling this way?
sentences.zh: 因此，我认为我们需要所有人都认真反思：你知道的，为什么我会有这种感觉？

sentences.en: But when it comes to policing, since it can have literally fatal consequences,
sentences.zh: 但说到警务工作，因为它可能会带来字面意义上的致命后果，

sentences.en: I have said in my first budget, we would put money into that budget to help us deal with implicit bias by retraining a lot of our police officers.
sentences.zh: 我在第一份预算中就说过，我们会拨款帮助应对内隐偏见，对我们的许多警官进行重新培训。

sentences.en: A few days later, during the vice presidential debate, Republican Mike Pence brought up the topic during his debate with Democratic Senator Tim Kaine.
sentences.zh: 几天后，在副总统辩论中，共和党人迈克·彭斯在与民主党参议员蒂姆·凯恩的辩论中提出了这个话题。

sentences.en: He said law enforcement personnel were feeling vilified by accusations of implicit bias.
sentences.zh: 他说，执法人员因为内隐偏见的指责而感到被污名化。

sentences.en: What we ought to do is we ought to stop seizing on these moments of tragedy.
sentences.zh: 我们应该做的是停止利用这些悲剧时刻。

sentences.en: We ought to assure the public that we'll have a full and complete and transparent investigation whenever there's a loss of life because of police action.
sentences.zh: 我们应该向公众保证，每当因警方执法而导致生命损失时，都会进行全面、彻底和透明的调查。

sentences.en: But, Senator, please, you know, enough of this seeking every opportunity to demean law enforcement broadly by making the accusation of implicit bias every time tragedy.
sentences.zh: 但是，参议员，拜托，你知道的，够了，不要每次发生悲剧时，都抓住一切机会通过指责内隐偏见来大肆贬低执法人员。

sentences.en: So on the one hand, Mazarin, it's kind of extraordinary that work done in an academic lab is getting debated in a presidential and vice presidential debate.
sentences.zh: 所以一方面，马扎林，学术实验室里的研究居然能在总统和副总统辩论中被讨论，这真是非同寻常。

sentences.en: That is kind of extraordinary.
sentences.zh: 这确实很不寻常。

sentences.en: And I think most researchers would never dream of something like that happening.
sentences.zh: 我想大多数研究人员做梦也没想到会发生这种事。

sentences.en: But what did you hear when Mike Pence said these words under the national spotlight?
sentences.zh: 但当迈克·彭斯在全国聚光灯下说出这些话时，你听到了什么？

sentences.en: I remember where I was when I heard it.
sentences.zh: 我记得听到这话时我在哪里。

sentences.en: It's a flashbulb memory.
sentences.zh: 这是一段闪光灯记忆。

sentences.en: I was in my home with all my graduate students, our jaws just dropped.
sentences.zh: 我和所有的研究生在家，我们的下巴都惊掉了。

sentences.en: They're talking about
sentences.zh: 他们在讨论

sentences.en: our little work.
sentences.zh: 我们的微小研究。

sentences.en: I would say that I have never gotten accustomed to this.
sentences.zh: 我想说，我从来没有习惯过这一点。

sentences.en: This happens so
sentences.zh: 这种事发生得太

sentences.en: frequently.
sentences.zh: 频繁了。
